اشترطتا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَطَتَا (ištaraṭatā) /iʃ.ta.ra.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اُشْتُرِطَتَا (ušturiṭatā) /uʃ.tu.ri.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
